rules.comments: Encoded PowerShell command on process start. Match a complete -enc or -EncodedCommand switch on powershell.exe or pwsh.exe; a substring inside an unrelated argument is insufficient.
Only PROCESS_START with complete, case-insensitive rundll32.exe and non-Explorer parent basenames is evidence for this alert.
A Temp executable creation alone is insufficient evidence for deletion. Keep this rule ID for compatibility and alert for investigation.
A Temp process start alone is insufficient evidence for termination. Keep this rule ID for compatibility and alert for investigation.
Registry Run and RunOnce autorun writes are case-insensitive; require a complete key segment to avoid similarly named non-autorun keys.
Only a mutating bcdedit /set recoveryenabled no|off command is matched; read-only enumeration and unrelated arguments remain silent.

Data sources: FILE_CREATE from file_fallback/startup_watch/sysmon ID 11/imonitor/driver (future).
Data sources: PROCESS_READ only from imonitor credential monitor (off by default).

Data sources: PROCESS_START from all process sources.
Data sources: REG_WRITE from driver reg/reg_watch/sysmon IDs 12-14; driver-only deployments do not trigger (same limitation as EDR-075).
Data sources: PROCESS_START from all process sources.
Data sources: PROCESS_START from all process sources.
Data sources: PROCESS_START from ETW/poll/imonitor/sysmon (the driver PROCESS_START event carries parent_image).
Data sources: chain_score written by the BehaviorEnricher (behavior_enrich config, off by default); only fires when the enricher is enabled. Log action for first-version noise control.
Data sources: DNS_QUERY from DNS ETW collector (enableDnsEtw config). Detects high-entropy subdomains typical of DNS tunneling / C2 beaconing.
Data sources: DNS_QUERY from DNS ETW collector. Detects excessive subdomain depth (e.g., many labels in query).
Data sources: DNS_QUERY from DNS ETW collector. Detects long domain labels (>52 chars) often used for data exfiltration.
Data sources: DNS_QUERY from DNS ETW collector. Detects suspicious TXT record queries often used for C2 payload retrieval.

Data sources: USB_DEVICE from the USB monitor collector (enable_usb_monitor, off by default). Detects new removable USB storage media; potential data exfiltration channel or malware propagation vector.

Data sources: NET_LISTENER from the listener monitor collector (enable_listener_monitor, off by default). A process outside the normal system set opens a listening TCP port; possible backdoor / C2 listener.
Data sources: NET_LISTENER from the listener monitor collector (off by default). A process begins listening on a non-standard high port; may indicate a staged C2 or exfiltration listener.
Data sources: SERVICE_CHANGE from the service monitor collector (enable_service_monitor, off by default). A service is created whose binary runs from a user-writable location; service persistence.

Data sources: CRITICAL_PROCESS from the critical process monitor collector (enable_critical_process_monitor, off by default). A protected security process (e.g. Windows Defender) has been terminated or is missing.

Data sources: FILE_READ from driver/minifilter/imonitor; PROCESS_START from all sources. Browser credential database access or credential decryption tools. Web browsers store passwords, cookies, and auto-fill data in encrypted local databases.

Data sources: FILE_READ from driver/minifilter/imonitor; PROCESS_START from all sources. SAM database or SYSTEM registry hive direct access. These files contain local account password hashes (LM/NTLM). Non-system processes reading these files indicate credential dumping.
Data sources: PROCESS_START from all sources. comsvcs.dll MiniDump pattern used to dump LSASS or other process memory without requiring procdump or mimikatz binaries on disk.

Data source: Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational event 1116. Defender reported a malware or potentially unwanted application detection. Review threat name, severity, path, process, and user context.
Data source: Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational event 5001. Defender real-time protection was disabled.
Data source: Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational event 5007. A Defender protection setting was changed to a disabled state. Event 5007 is otherwise retained as telemetry without alerting.
Data source: Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational event 1117. Defender attempted a response action but reported a failure or incomplete remediation status.
File Integrity Monitoring - critical system file modified. Detects changes to monitored system files that may indicate tampering or malware installation.
FIM - new executable created in monitored location. May indicate malware deployment.
FIM - critical file deleted. May indicate anti-forensic or ransomware behavior.
FIM - baseline established for a new file. Informational only.
New SMB share created. May indicate lateral movement preparation or data exfiltration channel.
SMB share removed. Informational.
SMB share modified - path or permissions changed. May indicate unauthorized share modification.
Host isolation triggered! The host has been isolated from the network due to a critical security event.
Process connecting to a configured malicious-IP test range. This user-mode rule alerts only; kernel enforcement policy is configured and audited separately.
Port scan detected - rapid connections to multiple ports. Possible reconnaissance.
Suspicious process started from user-writable location with network connectivity. Possible phishing payload.

Data source: RPC_CREATE_PROCESS from the iMonitor RPC-create-process hook (enable_hooks_rpc_create_process, off by default). A process was created through an RPC/DCOM server rather than as a direct child, and the created image runs from a user-writable location. Classic DCOM-based execution or lateral movement.

Data source: RPC_CREATE_PROCESS from the iMonitor RPC-create-process hook. The command line of a remotely created process contains scripted or encoded content (encoded PowerShell, download cradles, scriptlet hosts). Scripted execution through a remote process-creation primitive.

Data source: WINDOWS_HOOK from the iMonitor SetWindowsHookEx hook (enable_hooks_windows_hook, off by default). A low-level keyboard or mouse hook was installed; low-level hooks observe input system-wide without a DLL and are a common keylogging primitive.

Data: WINDOWS_HOOK from the iMonitor SetWindowsHookEx hook. A hook DLL located in a user-writable directory was installed; SetWindowsHookEx injects the hook DLL into every hooked thread of the target process, enabling cross-process code execution.

Data: SERVICE_INSTALL_HOOK from the iMonitor CreateService hook (enable_hooks_service, off by default). A Windows service was created whose binary path resides in a user-writable location. Service persistence with a user-controlled image.

Data: SERVICE_START_HOOK from the iMonitor StartService hook. A process running from a user-writable location started a Windows service; starting services usually requires elevation or SYSTEM context, so a process from a user-writable location doing so must be reviewed.

Data: SERVICE_CONFIG_CHANGE from the iMonitor ChangeServiceConfig hook. A process running from a user-writable location modified an existing service configuration (binary path, start type, account). Unauthorized service reconfiguration.

Data: CO_INSTANCE from the iMonitor CoCreateInstance hook (enable_hooks_com, off by default). A COM class commonly abused for scripted execution, macro payloads, or DCOM lateral movement was instantiated.

Data: SECTION_MAP from the iMonitor MapViewOfSection hook (enable_hooks_injection, off by default). A section backed by a user-writable image was mapped into another process. Cross-process section mapping is a DLL-injection primitive.

Data: HANDLE_DUPLICATE from the iMonitor DuplicateHandle hook (enable_hooks_handle, off by default). A handle was duplicated; duplicating a LSASS handle from another process enables credential material access through an already-open handle.

Data: INPUT_SIMULATION from the iMonitor SendInput hook (enable_hooks_input, off by default). A process outside the routine input-simulation set synthesized keyboard or mouse input. UI-based credential theft, clickjacking, or UAC-bypass automation.

Data: SYSTEM_TIME_CHANGE from the iMonitor SetSystemTime hook (enable_hooks_system, off by default). The system clock was changed by a process. Clock manipulation breaks certificate validity checks, log ordering, and forensic timelines.

Data: WALLPAPER_CHANGE from the iMonitor SetDeskWallpaper hook (enable_hooks_surveillance, off by default). The desktop wallpaper was changed by a process other than the shell/system; ransomware and defacement payloads commonly swap wallpapers with ransom images.

Data: CAMERA_ACCESS from the iMonitor camera hook (enable_hooks_surveillance, off by default). The camera was opened by a process outside the routine video-conferencing set. Unauthorized camera capture.

Data: CLIPBOARD_ACCESS from the iMonitor GetClipboardData hook (enable_hooks_surveillance, off by default). Text-format clipboard content was read by a process outside the routine clipboard-consuming set. Clipboard theft of credentials, tokens, or sensitive text.

Data: KEYLOGGER from the iMonitor keylogger hook (enable_hooks_surveillance, off by default). A keylogging primitive fired (raw-input capture or low-level keyboard monitoring); keyloggers steal credentials and sensitive typed content.

Data: POWERSHELL_HOOK from the iMonitor PowerShell hook (enable_hooks_powershell, off by default). A PowerShell script or command containing offensive markers (encoded command, download cradles, injection APIs, bypass flags) was executed.

Data: APC_INJECT enriched by the InjectionChainDetector (inject_chain config, off by default). An APC injection fired on a (source, target) pair that already accumulated an injection chain score of at least 60, i.e. a prior cross-process ACCESS plus WRITE step: classic inject-then-execute primitive.

Data: inject_chain_score written by the InjectionChainDetector (inject_chain config, off by default). A THREAD_CREATE on a (source, target) pair whose chain already includes ACCESS plus WRITE plus EXECUTE steps (score 70+): full WriteProcessMemory + CreateRemoteThread sequence.

Data: SECTION_MAP from the iMonitor section hook + cross_process flag. A cross-process section map of a module in a user-writable directory (Users/Public/Temp/AppData/ProgramData/Downloads) into another process: reflective loading of attacker-supplied code.

Data: HANDLE_DUPLICATE from the iMonitor handle hook (enable_hooks_handle, off by default). A handle to lsass.exe was duplicated across processes: the standard prelude to lsass access/credential dumping.

Data: RPC_CREATE_PROCESS from the iMonitor RPC hook (enable_hooks_rpc_create_process, off by default). A remote process was created via RPC and its image lives in a user-writable directory: lateral-movement / remote-execution shape.

Data: WINDOWS_HOOK from the iMonitor windows-hook hook (enable_hooks_windows_hook, off by default). A SetWindowsHookEx with thread id 0 installs a global (cross-process) hook, typically a keylogger or message interceptor.

Data: inject_chain_stage/inject_chain_score written by the InjectionChainDetector (inject_chain config, off by default). A process read of a credential target on an injection pair whose chain reached the READ stage: the injecting process turns around and reads lsass/winlogon/csrss.

Data: attack_chain_score written by the AttackChainDetector (attack_chain config, off by default). A process start arrives while its pid already carries four or more distinct attack-chain tactics (60+ score): multi-stage campaign shape on one process.

Data sources: chain_score/chain_reasons written by the BehaviorEnricher (behavior_enrich config, off by default). An executable started from a user-writable directory with a chain score of at least 50. Log action for first-version noise control.

Data: lsass_read_burst_bytes written by the BehaviorEnricher (behavior_enrich config, off by default). A single process dumped 10 MB or more from lsass.exe within the burst window: characteristic of full-memory credential harvesting.

NET_CONNECT using a fixed high EVEN source port in 20000-65534. Fast-path client connections use ephemeral ports; a stable high even source port is consistent with crafted/beaconing sockets. First-version log action keeps noise low. Source is NET_CONNECT events emitted by the ETW network collector (or any source that populates src_port).

UDP NET_CONNECT (protocol=udp) to the 192.168.200.0/24 test-lab range. Requires the network collector's UDP events which are off by default (net_etw_udp true to enable). Existing EDR-100 alerts on 192.168.100./10.0.99.; this rule deliberately uses the 192.168.200. range and the protocol field, so it does not overlap.
PROCESS_START of systeminfo.exe or hostname.exe - system/OS discovery, an early reconnaissance step.
whoami.exe with /all, /user or /priv - user-identity and privilege-set discovery.
ipconfig /all or route print - network interface and routing configuration discovery.
sc.exe query or tasklist /svc - enumeration of installed services and running process/service map.
Outbound NET_CONNECT to TCP 3389 - remote desktop protocol connection; common lateral-movement and remote-control channel.
wmic.exe with process call create or class/node usage - WMI-based process creation and remote automation.
odbcconf.exe abuse - signed Windows tool that executes DLLs via /a {REGSVR ...} - living-off-the-land execution.
msiexec.exe installing a package from a URL or silently (/q) - signed-box execution bypasses allow-lists.
REG_WRITE setting the Start value of the system event-log service to 0 (disabled) - impairs logging on boot.
REG_WRITE registering a DLL as a print/port monitor under Control\Print\Monitors - boot persistence via port-monitor loading.
net.exe / net1.exe enumerating user accounts or local groups - permission/group discovery, precursor to escalation.
shutdown.exe forcing immediate reboot (/r /t 0) or /f - machine-restart abuse common in impact / ransomware scenarios; low severity avoids operator fatigue.

C2 beacon enrichment (C2BeaconDetector, opt-in via c2_beacon.enable in config, off by default) stamps NET_CONNECT events with c2_beacon_score = min(100, repeatCount*20) when >= c2_beacon.min_repeat_endpoints distinct destinations each have >= c2_beacon.min_connections_per_endpoint connections in the window. Noisy - tune the config thresholds upward or downgrade the action to log if false positives dominate.

Ransomware burst enrichment (RansomBurstDetector, opt-in via ransom_burst.enable, off by default) stamps FILE_CREATE events with bulk_file_score when >= ransom_burst.min_file_count files with >= ransom_burst.min_distinct_extensions distinct extensions are created in the window - potential bulk-encryption pattern. Noisy - tune the config thresholds upward or downgrade the action to log if false positives dominate.

Data: driver PROCESS_STOP (source=driver) 对关键系统进程终止。ETW/Poll 的 PROCESS_STOP 无 image 字段，故本规则只在 driver 源生效。proc_notify L166-172 PROCESS_STOP 的 image 是短名（如 winlogon.exe），故正则需兼容有无反斜杠两种形态。log 行动避免误报（如系统账号注销、服务重启）。
Data: driver STATS 事件；采集队列近满时驱动把丢事件数写进 dropped_events。该字段在 STATS 事件上真实存在（parser L30）。用于遥测降级/合规信号。
Data: SYSTEM_SHUTDOWN 来自 iMonitor HookShutdownSystem (默认离线)。过滤常规关闭主体；非常规关机/重启行为留痕。shutdown_restart 可由用户判断。
Data: sysmon-origin IMAGE_LOAD (enrich 后 signature_status/rep 字段)。无有效签名的镜像从用户可写目录加载。
Data: sysmon-origin PROCESS_START，签名盖不可信/吊销/过期。
Data: FILE_CREATE (仅 sysmon+信誉开关) 写临时目录的无签名可执行文件。低严重避免噪音。
IFEO 下为辅助程序 (sethc/osk/magnify/utilman) 添加 Debugger 值。driver reg 名单已含 IFEO 键；驱动 wire 格式 reg_key=父键路径、reg_value=值名（已核对 reg_notify.c L193-206），故先按两字段分开匹配。与 EDR-037 互补限缩到辅助工具。
AppInit_DLLs 注入，依赖驱动 reg 名单补丁添加 kAppInit 键（本计划）。reg_key=父键、reg_value=值名，分开匹配避免依赖 REG_VALUE=数据的误判。若该补丁未合入则规则不触发，评审可考虑降级为 Deferred。
LSA SecurityPackages 安装盗取 SSP — 需驱动 reg 名单补 Lsa（本计划补丁）。依赖该路径采集。
COM InProcServer32 hijack — 需驱动 reg 名单补 kCLSID（本计划补丁）；同时依赖 sysmon 注册表 12-14 才可能带出详细数据。
wmiprvse.exe 启动 — WMI provider host，横向移动/远程 WMI 执行的常驻进程。不依赖 parent_image（process_poll 无该字段）；image 兼容完整路径与 basename（ETW 源为完整路径），匹配仅 image。
出站 TCP 连接 5985/5986 — WinRM 远程管理/横向移动通道。net_etw/network_poll 均可命中；5986 为 EDR-101 端口扫描列表之外的空白补齐。
net use / net session / net share — SMB 共享枚举与挂载，横向移动准备或数据外传通道。与 EDR-149（user/localgroup/group）互补。
at.exe 计划任务 — 历史横向移动/计划执行原语。at.exe 稀有，中危防噪，log 行动。
rundll32.exe 带 UNC 或 HTTP 参数 — 远程加载 DLL/脚本（T1218.011 经典）。管理工具误报风险：注释标注需调优。
psexec 命令行 — Sysinternals PsExec 远程执行。含合法运维使用，噪声风险高；注释标注需调优（可降级 log）。
Logon Type 3 网络登录成功（4624）— 远程认证横向移动。operation_type=LOGON 限定成功登录，避免与 EDR-022（4625 失败登录）重复告警。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
Security 频道 1102 — 审计日志被清除，明确反取证信号。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
Security 频道 1100 — 事件日志服务关闭，可能是维护也可能是清理前置。log 行动防噪。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
attrib +h — 隐藏文件/目录（反取证）。log 行动控噪。
icacls — ACL 修改/提权反取证。低危防噪。
takeown — 文件所有权夺取（反取证/权限滥用）。低危防噪。
cipher /w — 磁盘空白空间覆写（数据销毁/反取证）。log 行动控噪。
fsutil usn deletejournal — 删除 USN 日志（反取证，清除文件系统取证痕迹）。
wevtutil epl — 事件日志导出（反取证/数据外传前收集）。EDR-025 仅覆盖 cl/clear-log，epl 为导出变体。log 行动控噪。

WMI 永久事件订阅启动（5859 Operation_EssStarted）— 持久化原语。5859 的 Query 是 filter WQL，高价值模式为事件类（__InstanceCreationEvent、RegistryValueChangeEvent、Win32_Process、Startup）；consumer 类型（CommandLine/ActiveScript）由 EDR-182 在 5861 绑定事件上检测。降低合法管理软件（SCCM/Defender 等）误报；如噪声可降级 log。数据源: Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational（enable_wmi 开关）。

WMI filter→consumer 绑定（5861 Operation_ESStoConsumerBinding）— CONSUMER 字段（→wmi_provider_name）带 consumer 类型，CommandLine/ActiveScript 即可执行持久化。NTEventLog 等非执行类不命中。数据源: Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational（enable_wmi 开关）。
关键进程恢复（critical_process_monitor recovered）— 受保护系统进程（lsass/winlogon/csrss 等）重新出现。恢复本身是正常运维信号，log 防噪；与 EDR-091（terminated）配对。
服务被删除（service_monitor removed）— 持久化服务移除或防御规避（删除安全产品服务）。快照 diff 模型检测。
服务配置修改（service_monitor modified，imagePath 变更）— 服务二进制路径被改可能指向恶意载荷。配置变更频繁，log 防噪；如噪声大可调优或删除。
账户密码更改（4723）或密码重置（4724）— 账户接管信号。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
账户禁用（4725）或启用（4722）— 可能是管理操作，也可能是为隐藏账户启用作准备。log 防噪。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
账户被锁定（4740）— 多次失败登录触发的账户锁定，暴力破解/凭据填充的强信号。log 记录；重复爆破枚举由 EDR-022（4625 失败登录）覆盖。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
USB 存储设备移除（usb_action removed）— 数据外传/取证场景低价值信号，log 记录。
账户被删除（4726）— 攻击者删除账户清除踪迹，或防御方移除失陷账户。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
进程句柄打开请求高权限访问（VM_READ|VM_WRITE|CREATE_THREAD）— 进程注入准备。数据源: 驱动 ObRegisterCallbacks 句柄监控。需 driver_enable_object_handle=true（默认关闭）。
lsass.exe 进程句柄打开 — 凭据窃取准备。数据源: 驱动 ObRegisterCallbacks 句柄监控。需 driver_enable_object_handle=true（默认关闭）。
文件在用户可写目录中被重命名 — 勒索软件文件加密/重命名模式。数据源: 驱动 Minifilter 文件重命名监控。
持久化注册表位置的值或键被删除 — 防御规避或清理痕迹。数据源: 驱动注册表删除监控。
本地账户被创建（local_account_monitor）— 新用户账户可能被用于持久化或隐藏后门。数据源: NetUserEnum 轮询，需 enable_local_account_monitor=true（默认关闭）。
受监控本地组（Administrators 等）成员被添加 — 权限提升/持久化。数据源: NetLocalGroupGetMembers 轮询，需 enable_local_account_monitor=true（默认关闭）。
Windows 防火墙规则被新增或修改 — 攻击者放行 C2/横向移动流量或禁用防护。数据源: 防火墙规则注册表轮询，需 enable_firewall_monitor=true（默认关闭）。
Token 权限提升 — SeDebugPrivilege 被非系统进程启用，可能用于窃取令牌或访问 LSASS。数据源: 安全日志 4672（特殊权限登录）或特权监控。
Token 创建/窃取 — 非系统进程使用 SeCreateToken 或 SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权创建或分配令牌，表明令牌窃取攻击。数据源: 安全日志 4703（令牌权限调整）或特权监控。
DLL 侧加载 — 可从用户可写目录写入的 DLL 被加载到进程中，表明 DLL 劫持/侧加载攻击。数据源: 映像加载监控。
已知 DLL 侧加载模式 — 从具有已知侧加载漏洞的系统进程目录加载 DLL（如 wininet.dll、version.dll 从非标准路径）。数据源: 映像加载监控。
已签名进程的 DLL 侧加载 — 尝试利用信任的已签名可执行文件从可写位置加载恶意 DLL。数据源: 映像加载监控。
ETW 提供程序被禁用 — 攻击者可能禁用 ETW 以逃避检测（如通过注册表禁用 Microsoft-Windows-Audit、Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process 等）。数据源: 注册表写入监控。
ETW 日志记录被禁用 — 攻击者可能通过注册表禁用整个 ETW 日志会话以逃避检测。数据源: 注册表写入监控。
命名管道被创建 — 新命名管道创建可能表明恶意软件正在建立 IPC 通道用于 C2 通信或横向移动。数据源: Named Pipe ETW 监控。
可疑命名管道连接 — 从非系统进程连接到命名管道，可能表明横向移动（如 Impacket、PsExec 等工具使用的命名管道）。数据源: Named Pipe ETW 监控。
SeDebugPrivilege 被非标准进程启用 — 典型令牌窃取/凭证访问前兆，常与 LSASS 内存读取关联。数据源: 安全日志或特权监控。
令牌重复 — 进程尝试复制或窃取高权限令牌，通常用于权限提升或防御规避。数据源: 安全日志 4703 或进程访问监控。
系统目录内文件被重命名(file_path 承载旧路径; minifilter 仅发射旧路径) = 系统文件操纵信号。与 EDR-193 用户可写目标互补。源: driver FILE_RENAME。
防火墙规则被删除（firewall_action removed）— 防御规避：移除安全/管理规则或放行恶意流量。数据源: collector_firewall。
线程句柄全访问打开(object_type=thread, access_mask 十进制 2000000..2099999 = 0x1F0000..0x1FFFFF, 含 THREAD_ALL_ACCESS=0x1F03FF=2032639) = 远程线程注入/操纵前兆。源: driver HANDLE_OPEN (ObRegisterCallbacks)。
本地账户被删除或修改（account_action removed|modified）— 攻击者删除账户清除踪迹，或防御方移除失陷账户。数据源: collector_local_account。
本地组成员被移除或修改（group_action removed|modified）— 提权组（Administrators/Remote Desktop Users 等）成员变更信号。数据源: collector_local_account。

暴力破解：LogonBruteForceDetector（opt-in via logon_brute_force.enable，默认关闭）在窗口内对同一 (src_ip, target_user) 的 Security 4625 失败登录计数；达到 logon_brute_force.min_failures 时在当前事件上打上 logon_brute_failures 派生字段，本规则仅匹配字段存在（阈值由配置决定，规则与具体阈值解耦）。本地交互失败（IpAddress=-）不计入。需 enable_security_log=true。dedup_seconds 控制持续攻击下的告警频率。
RDP 远程交互登录成功（Security 4624, LogonType=10, T1021.001）。合法管理员 RDP 也会命中——如误报过多请降级为 log。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
远程网络登录（LogonType 3/8/10）携带完整提升令牌（4624 ElevatedToken=%%1842）— 高特权远程登录，可能是 Pass-the-Hash / 远程提权信号。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
Kerberoasting 信号：Security 4769 服务票据请求使用 RC4-HMAC（TicketEncryptionType=0x17）且成功（FailureCode=0x0）— 可离线爆破的服务账户票据。RC4 也是许多遗留应用的正常加密类型，噪音高，故用 log 行动；先观察再决定是否告警。需 enable_security_log=true（默认关闭）。
PowerShell 添加 Windows Defender 排除项（Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath/Process/Extension）— 攻击者常将恶意载荷路径/进程/扩展名加入排除以规避检测。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。合法管理脚本也可能命中，请按环境微调或降级。

PowerShell 关闭 Windows Defender 实时监控相关功能（Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring/IOAVProtection/BehaviorMonitoring/OnAccessProtection/ScriptScanning/ScanOnRealtimeEnable）— 典型防御规避（T1562.001）。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
关闭 Windows Defender 篡改防护（Set-MpPreference -DisableTamperProtection）— 篡改防护是防御 Agent 自我修改的最后屏障，关闭后攻击者可持久禁用 Defender。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
降低 Windows Defender 遥测/云保护（Set-MpPreference -DisableBlockAtFirstSeen / -PUAProtection 0 / -MAPSReporting 0 / -SubmitSamplesConsent 2）— 攻击者通过减少上报降低被杀/被发现概率。噪音偏高（部分策略加固也会用到），用 log 行动先观察。
停止/禁用安全产品服务（sc stop/config、net stop、Stop-Service 针对 WinDefend/WdNisSvc/SecurityHealthService/Sense/MsMpEng/mpssvc/wscsvc/Sysmon/EventLog 等）— 攻击者先停掉防护再执行后续攻击。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。合法运维也会命中，请按环境微调。
强杀安全产品进程（taskkill /f /im、Stop-Process、wmic ... delete 针对 MsMpEng.exe/MsSense.exe/SecurityHealthService.exe/mpcmdrun.exe）— 攻击者终止 AV/EDR 进程以规避检测。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
Sysmon 被卸载或服务被禁用（Sysmon -u/-uninstall、sc stop/config/delete Sysmon、net stop Sysmon）— 攻击者移除第三方日志收集器以逃避审计。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
注册表关闭 Windows Defender 篡改防护（HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features\TamperProtection=0 或 DisableTamperProtection=1）。数据源: REG_WRITE（Sysmon 12-14；reg_watch/驱动兴趣列表不含此路径）。
禁用 AMSI 脚本扫描（SOFTWARE\Microsoft\AMSI\DisableScriptScanning=1 或 Windows Script\Settings\AmsiEnable=0）— AMSI 禁用后脚本类恶意内容不再被 AV 引擎检查。数据源: REG_WRITE（Sysmon 12-14；reg_watch/驱动兴趣列表不含此路径）。
PowerShell 关闭 Windows 防火墙（Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled False / Set-NetFirewallRule -Enabled False）— 与 EDR-076（netsh）互补，覆盖 PS 命令路径。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
加载已知易受攻击的签名驱动（BYOVD, T1068）— RTCore64/gdrv/ProcessHacker/dbUtil/IQVW64E 等被滥用来加载后写入内核或关闭 EDR 保护。这些驱动本身是合法签名的，若正常产品使用请排除或降级。数据源: IMAGE_LOAD（驱动映像加载回调或 ETW 映像加载，需相应收集器启用）。
删除卷影副本（wmic shadowcopy delete / Win32_ShadowCopy 删除 / Remove-WmiObject ShadowCopy）— 与 EDR-026（vssadmin）互补，破坏系统还原点以阻碍恢复。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
禁用或清空审计策略（auditpol /set ... /success:disable /failure:disable、auditpol /clear）— 攻击者关闭审计类别以隐藏活动。数据源: PROCESS_START 命令行。
禁用 LSA 保护（HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL=0 或 RunAsPPLBoot=0）— 降低 LSASS 保护以便后续凭证转储（T1003 前置）。数据源: REG_WRITE（Sysmon 12-14；reg_watch/驱动兴趣列表不含此路径）。

受保护的防御性 ETW provider 被禁用（etw_tamper_type=provider_disabled，如 Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Sysmon/AMSI 或内核 Process/Network/DNS）— 攻击者停用 ETW provider 以阻止遥测产生（T1562.001）。数据源: ETW 篡改收集器（enable_etw_tamper_monitor，默认关闭）。

进程 ntdll.dll!EtwEventWrite 函数序言被内存补丁（etw_tamper_type=etw_event_write_patched）— patchETW 类工具用提前返回覆盖 ETW 写入函数以静默所有 ETW 遥测。数据源: ETW 篡改收集器（需 etw_tamper_scan_processes=true，默认关闭）。若其他安全产品 hook ntdll ETW 函数，请在 etw_tamper_skip_images 排除或降级为 log。
agent 自身的 ETW 跟踪会话被停止（etw_tamper_type=session_stopped，EDR-Proctrace-/EDR-NetTrace-/EDR-DnsTrace-/EDR-PipeTrace-）— 攻击者拆除会话以停止进程/网络/DNS/管道遥测。数据源: ETW 篡改收集器（enable_etw_tamper_monitor，默认关闭）。

Process hollowing masquerading/staging proxy (ProcessHollowingDetector, opt-in via process_hollowing.enable, off by default) stamps PROCESS_START events with hollow_score when a protected system binary basename (svchost.exe, lsass.exe, ...) runs from outside the trusted system directory prefixes (+55 outside_system_dir), is staged in a user-writable location (+25 user_writable_path), or is launched by an unusual parent such as an Office application, browser, or script host (+20 unusual_parent, booster only). Path/parent heuristic only - no memory-region inspection. Scores 50..100 alert here; tune process_hollowing.min_score or downgrade the action if noisy.

Low-confidence band (scores 20..49) of the ProcessHollowingDetector hollow_score derived field. Cannot fire under the default process_hollowing.min_score of 55 because the detector only stamps events at or above min_score; this rule takes effect only when an operator deliberately lowers min_score below 50. Log action only by design - staging-only signals (user_writable_path without outside_system_dir) land in this band.

Opt-in DNS query-volume/high-entropy enrichment (dns_beacon.enable, default off). Counts completed queries in the strict (event_time - window, event_time] sliding window, isolated by endpoint, source and reliable process instance. Both configured query-count and high-entropy-count thresholds must be met. Score is min(100, retained query count); this deliberately uses the legacy 20..100 band, not the 55+ house band. EDR-244 covers 10..19. A rising episode can emit again when it crosses into this higher band; repeats within the same band are suppressed. Statistical evidence merits investigation and does not prove C2 or tunneling. Alert only; no automatic response.

Lower-confidence DNS query-volume/high-entropy band (same opt-in dns_beacon detector and strict process-instance sliding window). Deliberate legacy score band 10..19; action=alert and severity=medium. Both configured thresholds must be met. Volume and entropy remain heuristic evidence. A later crossing into 20..100 emits EDR-243 once; falling below the detection thresholds rearms the episode. No automatic response.

Lateral movement / internal host scanning (LateralMovementDetector, opt-in via lateral_move.enable, off by default). Stamps NET_CONNECT events with lateral_move_score when a process connects to at least lateral_move.min_dest_count distinct destination IPs on lateral-movement ports (SMB/445, RDP/3389, WinRM/5985-5986, RPC/135, NetBIOS/139, SSH/22, Telnet/23, VNC/5900) within the window. Score = min(100, destCount * score_per_dest). Loopback (127.*) excluded. Tune min_dest_count upward to reduce noise from legitimate admin tools.

Lower-confidence lateral movement band (LateralMovementDetector, same opt-in). Score 15..39 covers early scans that have not yet reached the high-confidence threshold. Log action 鈥?single-tool admin or IT automation commonly touches multiple hosts on management ports.

RAT analyzer MALICIOUS verdict (collector rat_analyzer, opt-in via enable_rat_analyzer, on in the shipped config). A running process scored >= 55: masquerading loader with abnormal parent, protected system basename outside System32, and/or analysis/anti-debug tool plus user-writable placement. Heuristic 鈥?tune rat_analyzer_min_score or downgrade to log if false positives dominate.

RAT analyzer SUSPICIOUS verdict (same opt-in collector). Score 30..54: loader or evasion signal without the full MALICIOUS combination. Heuristic 鈥?legitimate security tools and debuggers on analyst machines score in this band; tune or downgrade.

RAT analyzer MONITOR verdict (same opt-in collector). Score 1..29: a weak single signal such as one analysis tool without other indicators. Log only 鈥?procmon/Wireshark-style utilities are routinely present on monitored machines.

RAT analyzer user-writable placement (same opt-in collector): a scored process runs from Temp/AppData/ProgramData/Public/Downloads/Desktop. Log action keeps the placement signal visible without double-alerting EDR-247/248, which already fire on the verdict bands.

Persistence chain enrichment (PersistenceChainDetector, opt-in via persist_chain.enable, off by default) stamps REG_WRITE/TASK_SCHEDULER/SERVICE_CHANGE/FILE_CREATE/WMI_EVENT events with persist_chain_score = min(100, count*25) when >= persist_chain.min_mechanisms (default 3) distinct persistence mechanisms are observed for one pid@image within persist_chain.window_seconds (default 600). A single actor registering multiple persistence shapes (run key + scheduled task + service + startup folder + WMI subscription) is a strong compromise signal. Noisy - tune min_mechanisms upward or downgrade to log.

Password spray correlation (PasswordSprayDetector, opt-in via password_spray.enable; Security 4625/4624 collection still requires enable_security_log=true). A remote source reached both the total-failure and distinct-user thresholds for logon types 3/8/10 inside the bounded window. Machine accounts, loopback/local sources, and unattributable events are ignored. VPN/NAT addresses, vulnerability scanners, stale service credentials, and help-desk activity can be noisy; tune both thresholds and the dedup interval.

A successful remote Security 4624 logon followed a detected password spray from the same source and targeted one of the sprayed accounts within password_spray.success_followup_seconds. This is a high-confidence compromised-account follow-through signal, but shared VPN/NAT sources and authorized authentication testing can still create false positives. Each source/account success is emitted once per spray episode.

Kerberoasting burst correlation (KerberoastDetector, opt-in via kerberoast_burst.enable; Security 4769 collection requires enable_security_log=true). One requester/source obtained successful RC4-HMAC tickets for multiple distinct eligible service principals inside the bounded window. Standalone krbtgt and machine-account-form ServiceName values are ignored; ordinary class/instance SPNs remain eligible because they do not reveal the backing account type. Legacy RC4 applications, service-account inventory, backup, and identity-audit systems can be noisy; tune min_service_count or downgrade to log.

LOLBin parent-child enrichment (LolbinParentChildDetector, opt-in via lolbin_parent_child.enable, off by default). Office/Adobe/browser/mail/chat/script-host parents spawning PowerShell, script hosts, or signed LOLBins score MALICIOUS at >= 70. Encoded, hidden-window, download-cradle, and remote-URL command lines raise the score. Software installers and mail preview handlers can false-positive; tune min_score or downgrade.
LOLBin parent-child SUSPICIOUS band (score 50..69). Log action keeps the signal visible without double-alerting EDR-255.

Ransomware precursor correlation (RansomPrecursorDetector, opt-in via ransom_precursor.enable). Two or more distinct anti-recovery techniques (shadow-copy delete, backup wipe, recovery disable, log clear, USN delete, free-space wipe) on the host inside the window. Individual techniques remain covered by EDR-025/026/027/028/177/178.
RDP session logon (TerminalServices LocalSessionManager 21). Requires enable_rdp_log=true. Log action: interactive RDP is common; pair with EDR-259 reconnects and EDR-170 network logons.
RDP session reconnect (LocalSessionManager 25). Session hijack (tscon / steal) and reconnect-after-disconnect both look like this; tune if jump-hosts are noisy.
WDigest UseLogonCredential registry write. Enabling WDigest stores plaintext credentials in LSASS. Covered by the registry watcher (enable_reg_watch).
netsh interface portproxy persistence (PortProxy v4tov4). Covered by the registry watcher when the key exists.
AppCertDlls persistence: DLLs listed here load into every process that calls CreateProcess.
SilentProcessExit MonitorProcess write. Attackers use this IFEO-adjacent key to launch a watcher when a process exits.
ntdsutil.exe start 鈥?NTDS.dit / IFM dump tool (T1003.003). Domain-controller administration is a legitimate source; tune on DCs.
esentutl copying NTDS.dit or SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM hive files.
tscon.exe session hijack / console attach. Help-desk and admin session restore can false-positive.
cmstp.exe silent or remote INF execution (T1218.003).
wmic process call create 鈥?remote or local process launch via WMI.
Accessibility binary replacement (sethc/utilman/osk/magnify/narrator/displayswitch) via copy/move/xcopy/robocopy.
netsh interface portproxy add 鈥?port forwarding / RDP tunnel helper. Complements EDR-261 registry coverage.

UAC bypass auto-elevation binaries (basename semantics, any directory): fodhelper.exe, computerdefaults.exe, eventvwr.exe. Paired with the EDR-282/283 registry-key writes these form the classic fodhelper/eventvwr UAC bypass chain.

UAC bypass registry key write: HKCU/HKU Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\Open\command (fodhelper bypass). Realistically sourced from Sysmon IDs 12-14; the registry watcher interest list does not cover this path.
UAC bypass registry key write: Software\Classes\mscfile\shell\open\command (eventvwr bypass). Same telemetry caveat as EDR-282.
sdclt.exe /kickoffelev UAC bypass invocation. Plain sdclt /logoff and renamed copies do not match.
wmic.exe XSL script execution via a remote (http/https) or user-writable (/format:C:\Users\...) stylesheet. Local system XSL files and built-in format names stay silent.
ftp.exe script-mode batch transfer (-s:script). Automated bulk file staging over FTP; interactive ftp sessions do not match.
curl -T / wget --post-file upload to a remote host (T1567.001). Plain downloads, headers-only probes and lookalike flags do not match.
Impacket tool family: python running wmiexec/smbexec/secretsdump/atexec/psexec modules, or standalone smbexec.exe-style binaries (incl. -hashes pass-the-hash).
net.exe/net1.exe local account creation (net user <name> <pass> /add). Plain queries and /address lookalikes do not match.
net.exe adding an account to the local administrators group (net localgroup administrators <name> /add).
sc.exe service creation whose binPath points into a user-writable location (Users, Temp, AppData, ProgramData). System paths and sc config do not match.
rundll32.exe loading a DLL from a user-writable directory (Users, Temp, AppData, ProgramData). System32 and tool-template paths stay silent.
certutil.exe -split / /split base64 decode (T1140). -splitter and -split-f lookalikes do not match.

Port-scan enrichment stamp (PortScanDetector, opt-in): NET_CONNECT events carrying port_scan_score 20..100. The detector only stamps 20+ (min_distinct_ports >= 5, score = portCount * 4 capped at 100).
AlwaysInstallElevated MSI policy write under Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer (HKLM or HKCU). Enabling it lets any user run MSI packages with elevated privileges.
Terminal Server root-key RDP-enablement writes: fDenyTSConnections / fSingleSessionPerUser under Control\Terminal Server. Other value names at the root key stay silent (see EDR-297/298).
RDP NLA disable: UserAuthentication write under WinStations\RDP-Tcp. The same value at the Terminal Server root key or other RDP-Tcp values do not match.
LSA DisableRestrictedAdmin rewrite under Control\Lsa (watcher-shaped suffix; the driver's parent-key events do not match this shape).

LOLBin chain enrichment (LolbinChainDetector, opt-in via lolbin_chain.enable): one parent image repeatedly launching suspicious child binaries (mshta/rundll32/powershell/...) inside the window. Score 55+.

PowerShell download-execute chain enrichment (PowerShellDownloadExecuteDetector, opt-in via powershell_download_execute.enable): repeated remote download-and-execute child launches by one parent. Score 55+.
RDP chain enrichment (RdpChainDetector, opt-in via rdp_chain.enable): the same user reaching the host from multiple source IPs inside the window. Score 55+.
UAC bypass chain enrichment (UacBypassDetector, opt-in via uac_bypass_chain.enable): an auto-elevation binary starts while bypass registry keys were recently written. Score 55+.
WMI event-subscription persistence enrichment (WmiPersistenceDetector, opt-in via wmi_persistence.enable): suspicious WMI __EventFilter/__EventConsumer operations. Score 55+.
Memory scanner enrichment (MemoryScannerDetector, opt-in via memory_scanner.enable): cross-process memory access combinations (read/write/query on a foreign process). Score 55+.
Driver load enrichment (DriverLoadDetector, opt-in via driver_load.enable): unsigned or vulnerable (BYOVD) kernel driver loads. Score 55+.
Fileless attack enrichment (FilelessAttackDetector, opt-in via fileless_attack.enable): in-memory PowerShell/WMI techniques (download-execute cradles, obfuscation, reflection). Score 55+.
API hook enrichment (ApiHookDetector, opt-in via api_hook.enable): inline hooks on ETW/AMSI/security APIs that impair telemetry. Score 55+.

DLL hijack enrichment (DllHijackDetector, opt-in via dll_hijack.enable): known hijack-target DLLs loaded from Temp/Downloads/ProgramData/Public/Profile. Score 68+ (the detector's minimum suspicious band).

Defense evasion correlation enrichment (DefenseEvasionDetector, opt-in via defense_evasion.enable): multiple distinct evasion techniques (log wipe, disable telemetry, AMSI bypass, ...) from one actor. Score 60+ (2+ techniques).

Discovery/recon correlation enrichment (DiscoveryReconDetector, opt-in via discovery_recon.enable): multiple distinct discovery techniques (system info, network config, account enumeration) from one actor. Score 75+ (3+ techniques).
Remote access / remote support tool enrichment (RemoteAccessDetector, opt-in via remote_access.enable): AnyDesk/TeamViewer-class tools plus listener/pipe/service signals. Score 55+.
shutdown.exe forced shutdown or reboot (/r, /s). Ransomware and destructive operations use this to disrupt recovery; /a aborts stay silent.
PowerShell Restart-Computer / Stop-Computer (T1529).
Virtualization/sandbox artifact query via wmic csproduct (T1497). Malware probes for VM firmware to skip analysis.
Virtual guest agent processes (vboxservice, VMware tools, QEMU guest agent, ...). Presence of a guest agent is normal on VMs; log-only context for EDR-314-style sandbox detection.
Destructive disk commands: diskpart /s clean scripts and format.com volume formatting (T1561).
Direct remote-access tool launch (AnyDesk). Unattended access tools on corporate endpoints warrant review.

Credential dumping detector (credential_dumping.enable) correlates LSASS memory access, SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hive file access, ntds.dit access, reg-save, and suspicious named-pipe creation. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.
Data exfiltration detector (data_exfiltration.enable) correlates outbound connections to external IPs, DNS tunneling, and bulk file reads. 55+ alerted.

Privilege escalation detector (privilege_escalation.enable) correlates suspicious service installs, token manipulation, SeDebugPrivilege, and DLL sideloading into elevated processes. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.
NTLM relay detector (ntlm_relay.enable) correlates NTLM Type-3 logons from multiple source IPs/workstations to same target account. 55+ alerted.
Browser credential theft detector (browser_theft.enable) detects non-browser processes accessing browser credential databases, cookie stores, and decryption keys. 55+ alerted.
Cryptominer detector (cryptominer.enable) detects known miner binaries, mining pool DNS queries, and stratum protocol connections. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.
Anti-analysis / sandbox evasion detector (anti_analysis.enable) detects VM detection, debugger checks, sleep bombing, and analysis-tool parent processes. 55+ alerted.
Archive staging detector (archive_staging.enable) correlates archive utility launches, archive reads/renames, and extraction into temp/download/profile locations. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Script host abuse detector (script_host_abuse.enable) flags wscript/cscript/mshta launching remote (http/UNC) payloads, inline mshta scripting, scripts staged in transient directories, encoded blob arguments, and script-host proxy execution. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Account operation detector (account_op.enable) flags malicious account management through net.exe/net1.exe/dsadd.exe: adding users to the local administrators group or domain groups, creating accounts, enabling disabled accounts, and password resets. 75+ malicious (admin/domain group adds) alerted by this rule; the 55-74 delete/disable signals route through EDR-495 (account_delete|account_disable token), and sub-55 events are never stamped.

Tunneling tool detector (tunnel_tool.enable) flags reverse/local/dynamic SSH or plink port forwards, netsh portproxy rules, netcat/socat listener relays, and packaged tunnel clients (ngrok, chisel, frp, ligolo, rinetd, iodine, dnscat2). 50+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

User-activity surveillance detector (surveillance.enable, off by default; data from the iMonitor surveillance hooks enable_hooks_surveillance). One process accumulating multiple distinct surveillance signals (clipboard access, keylogging, wallpaper/camera capture) inside the window, or running a known surveillance-tool binary. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Web shell staging detector (webshell.enable, off by default). Script files (php/aspx/asp/jsp/...) created inside web roots (inetpub\wwwroot, htdocs, xampp, phpstudy, ...); suspicious basenames (cmd, shell, c99, r57, ...) or non-webserver writers raise the score. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Removable-media exfiltration detector (usb_exfil.enable, off by default). File creation/rename activity on known removable drives: bulk copies and copies of sensitive documents (doc/xls/pdf/db/key stores/...) are scored. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Registry-based persistence detector (registry_persistence.enable, off by default). Flags processes writing to known persistence locations (Run keys, IFEO Debugger, Winlogon, AppInit_DLLs, LSA packages, WMI subscriptions, service ImagePath). Distinct mechanism accumulation with rising-edge stamping; score 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Anti-forensics detector (anti_forensics.enable, off by default). Consumes AUDIT_LOG events: Security log cleared (1102) scored 55; event-log service stop (1100) scored 20; repeated clears or clear+stop within window escalate. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

System time-change evasion detector (time_change.enable, off by default). Parses 4616 security events; clock rollbacks scored 65 (temporal anti-analysis adjacent to T1070.006), large forward jumps 45, moderate shifts stamped below alerting; NTP-scale corrections ignored. Repeated rollbacks escalate to 80. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Privileged-group membership detector (privileged_group.enable, off by default). Parses Security 4728/4732/4756 member-add events; additions to sensitive groups (Administrators/Domain Admins/Enterprise Admins/Schema Admins/Backup Operators/Account Operators/Server Operators/Remote Desktop Users) score 60 and alert immediately; repeated sensitive adds or volume escalation reach 80+. Non-sensitive group churn stays visible below the band. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Firewall rule detector (firewall_rule.enable, off by default) flags suspicious inbound allow rules, RDP exposure, any-protocol rules, and rules allowing scripting or tunneling tools. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.
Share change detector (share_change.enable, off by default) flags new or modified SMB disk shares targeting sensitive paths and hidden administrative shares. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Local account detector (local_account.enable, off by default) flags new suspicious users and additions to privileged local groups such as Administrators, Backup Operators, and Remote Desktop Users. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

BITS abuse detector (bits_abuse.enable, off by default) flags bitsadmin/Start-BitsTransfer download or upload jobs pulling from remote URLs into executable or transient paths (LOLBITS). 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

DoH abuse detector (doh_abuse.enable, off by default) flags processes resolving known DNS-over-HTTPS resolver endpoints, especially non-browser tools, repeated lookups, and multi-provider bootstrap bursts that bypass local DNS monitoring. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Service install detector (svc_install.enable, off by default) flags 4697 service creations with transient-dir or LOLBin binaries, encoded PowerShell cradles, web/UNC payloads, and auto-start persistence. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

System-restore suppression detector (shadow_copy.enable, off by default) flags deletion of Volume Shadow Copies and recovery-disable commands: vssadmin delete shadows /all (90), per-volume vssadmin deletes (75), wmic shadowcopy delete (75), PowerShell Win32_ShadowCopy removal (70), wbadmin delete catalog (70), and bcdedit recoveryenabled off (60). Shadow wipe combined with recovery-disable escalates to 95. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Canary file honeypot (canary.enable, off by default): any interaction with a deployed decoy document - read access (60), modification/replacement (80), or deletion (90). Legitimate software never touches canaries, so every hit is high-confidence. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

COR_PROFILER hijack (T1574.012): CorProfilerHijackDetector (cor_profiler_hijack.enable, off by default) catches COR_ENABLE_PROFILING plus COR_PROFILER/CLSID environment writes and registry keys that force the CLR to load an attacker DLL into any managed process, including SYSTEM services. 95 = profiler armed and named, 90 = profiler env var written / CLSID injected / reg-add armed, 85 = env var set or path pointed at a DLL, 80 = loading armed. All reachable values are >=80, so every stamp alerts.

Credential-file hunting: CredentialFileHuntDetector (cred_file_hunt.enable, off by default) flags findstr/grep/select-string/ripgrep sweeps for password material plus direct reference to credential-bearing files (unattend.xml, sysprep.inf, web.config, .kdbx, .netrc, WinSCP.ini, SSH private keys). 75 = recursive or read/copy verb present, 70 = credential file or store referenced, 65 = findstr or bare keepass/net-use hint. 55+ alerted; 70+ here.

DCSync (T1003.006): DcsyncDetector (dcsync.enable, off by default) matches lsadump::dcsync, secretsdump -just-dc, Invoke-DCSync and standalone dcsync tools. Replicating the directory from a non-DC principal yields every domain hash, so every reachable score (80-90) is critical. Complements credential_dumping and reg_cred_hunt which read the local hive instead.

Developer-utility proxy execution: DevUtilProxyDetector (dev_util_proxy.enable, off by default) covers MSBuild inline tasks, csc/vbc/jsc/ilasm compilation from user-writable paths, InstallUtil and Workflow.Compiler proxy execution. 90 = MSBuild inline task, 85 = csc / InstallUtil from writable path, 80 = jsc / ilasm / Workflow.Compiler, 75 = MSBuild user-writable project or vbc. Complements EDR-350 (cmstp), indirect_exec and dotnet_proxy_exec. 55+ alerted; all reachable values are >=75.

Disk/volume destruction: DiskWipeDetector (disk_wipe.enable, off by default) matches diskpart clean/clean all, format /q and full format on a drive letter, cipher /w free-space wipe and Clear-Disk/Format-Volume. 90 = diskpart clean all, 85 = diskpart clean or full format, 75 = quick format, 70 = PowerShell volume wipe, 60 = cipher free-space wipe. Complements ransom_burst and shadow_copy (recovery inhibition). 55+ alerted; 75+ here.

Sustained password guessing against one account: LogonBruteForceDetector (logon_brute_force.enable, off by default) accumulates Security 4625 failures per (src_ip, target_user) inside window_seconds and stamps logon_brute_score = min(100, failures). 25 or more failures against a single account is no longer a mistyped password but a deliberate guessing campaign. EDR-220 fires on any batch; this rule separates the sustained case. Requires enable_security_log=true.

Heavy password guessing: 50 or more failed logons for the same (src_ip, target_user) pair within one window, i.e. the failure counter saturated and the source kept going across at least one cooldown cycle. At this volume the account may already be compromised and the password spray boundary (T1110.003) is worth ruling out via EDR-252. Same detector and prerequisites as EDR-462.
wevtutil sl <channel> /e:false or /e:0 disables a Windows event channel. Requires the real wevtutil executable and PROCESS_START; a status query or /e:true or /e:1 does not match.
PowerShell Clear-EventLog on a named channel. Complements wevtutil cl and avoids matching Get-EventLog queries.

Event log tampering: EventlogTamperDetector (eventlog_tamper.enable, off by default) scores wevtutil cl / Clear-EventLog / Remove-EventLog / auditpol /clear and channel disable via wevtutil sl /e:false. 90 = Security log clear, 85 = channel disabled, 80 = audit policy cleared, 75 = generic log clear, 55 = log enumeration. This rule covers SUSPICIOUS >=55. See EDR-467 for MALICIOUS >=75.
Event log tampering (MALICIOUS): same detector as EDR-466 but high confidence >=75 (generic clear or worse). Security log clear (90) and channel disable (85) land here.

SSH abuse: SshAbuseDetector (ssh_abuse.enable, off by default) scores ssh.exe/plink.exe with suspicious options: StrictHostKeyChecking=no (+ null known hosts) 90/85, -i identity file 80, BatchMode/ -f -N 75, -p port 60, plain remote 55. This rule covers SUSPICIOUS >=55. See EDR-469 for MALICIOUS >=75.
SSH abuse (MALICIOUS): same detector as EDR-468 but high confidence >=75 (host key disabled, identity file, batch mode).

reg.exe add writes Enabled=0 as REG_DWORD under a WINEVT Channels subkey to disable event collection. Matches the actual command when registry data is unavailable to REG_WRITE rules; does not match Enabled=1, another value name or a different registry branch.

bcdedit /set <store> bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures suppresses the recovery UI after boot failures and is a recovery-inhibition precursor. Match only the real bcdedit executable and the mutating /set form with a complete ignoreallfailures token; read-only enum/query commands and other boot policy values remain outside this rule.
Attempt to disable Windows Event Log service startup through sc.exe config EventLog start= disabled. Require PROCESS_START and the real sc.exe image; query and automatic startup changes stay silent.
Attempt to disable Windows Event Log service startup using PowerShell Set-Service -Name EventLog -StartupType Disabled. Read-only Get-Service and other service names remain silent.

Process-discovery mapping correction: HostProfileDetector (host_profile.enable, opt-in) attributes its process-enumeration category (tasklist / Get-Process / Get-CimInstance Win32_Process / wmic process / pslist / driverquery / fltmc) to T1057 Process Discovery. The earlier rules mapped this category to T1007 System Service Discovery. Only fires on the multi-category breadth band, so single admin tasklist runs stay silent.

Browser cookie-store theft mapping: BrowserTheftDetector (browser_theft.enable, opt-in) stamps browser_theft_data_types when a non-browser process reads Chromium Cookies/cookies.sqlite or Firefox cookie stores. Reading the cookie jar steals the live web session (T1539 Steal Web Session Cookie); the same detector's login-data shape is T1555.003 Credentials from Web Browsers. The existing EDR-321 band already fires on the score; this rule records the correct sub-technique alongside T1555.003. Mapping correction 2026-10-03: the previous T1552.003 tag was wrong (T1552.003 is Unsecured Credentials: Bash History, a Linux shell-history technique with no relation to browser cookies).

Security-tool modification mapping: AvTamperDetector (av_tamper.enable, opt-in) covers Defender-specific disablement (Set-MpPreference DisableRealtimeMonitoring family, exclusions, MpCmdRun -RemoveDefinitions, protected-service stop, tamper policy values). This is T1562.005 Disable or Modify Tools, recorded alongside T1562.001. The signal itself is unchanged; this rule carries the sub-technique mapping.

Software discovery detector (software_discovery.enable, off by default). A full three-facet software census scores 75 (malicious); two facets score 60. Enumerating security products (SecurityCenter2 / Get-MpComputerStatus / sc query WinDefend / AV vendor strings) floors the score at 70, or 90 when the actor is privileged. A lone `wmic product get` is routine administration and stays silent. Complements host_profile (EDR-474), which has no software-inventory or AV-product category. 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Software discovery baseline observability (software_discovery.enable, off by default): logs the two-facet software census band (score 60-74) so operators can tune min_categories and whitelist inventory agents, software portals and patch scanners before EDR-477 fires.

Network share discovery burst (net_share_discovery.enable, off by default). Six or more distinct share-discovery commands score 85, five score 75, four score 70 and three (the default min_commands) score 60. Adding both a local enumeration form (net view / wmic share get / Get-SmbShare) and a remote UNC form (dir \\host\share / Get-ChildItem \\host) adds 10 for the enumerate-then-pivot shape, and a privileged actor adds 10; capped at 100. A single share probe is routine and stays silent. Complements net_discovery (T1018/T1049) and share_change (T1021.002/T1070.005). 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Network share discovery baseline observability (net_share_discovery.enable, off by default): logs the burst band below the malicious floor (score 60-74, three or four distinct share commands) so administrators can raise min_commands or whitelist software-deployment agents that enumerate shares before EDR-479 fires.

Non-standard port egress shape (nonstandard_port_egress.enable, off by default). Scores from outbound connection shape over NET_CONNECT: unusual destination port 25, five or more distinct destination hosts 25, four or more distinct ports 20, raw protocol or classic raw port (1337/4444/5555/6666/31337) 25, twelve or more connections in the window 15. many_hosts plus many_ports alone floors at 55; volume alone never reaches the floor. Twenty-four well-known ports (including 443, 8080 and 8443) are silent by themselves. Complements tunnel_tool (T1572/T1090, known tools) and doh_abuse (T1071.004). 55+ alerted; 75+ malicious.

Non-standard port egress baseline observability (nonstandard_port_egress.enable, off by default): logs the fan-out band at the suspicious floor (score 55-74) where a single process reached many hosts and many ports but no unusual or raw port, so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-481 fires.

Privileged software census (software_discovery.enable, off by default): a privileged actor that reaches both the breadth floor and the security-product floor scores 90 malicious. Security-product enumeration by an elevated actor is the strong T1518.001 case where the attacker is mapping which security tooling is installed before disabling it (see EDR-476 / T1562.005 for the tamper side).

Mailbox rule exfiltration, forward tiers (mailbox_rule.enable, off by default): MailboxRuleDetector forward tiers - 90 = inbox rule forwarding (forwarding targets captured for review; the detector does not classify internal vs external addresses), 85 = mailbox-level SMTP forwarding. Every arriving message is relayed to whatever target the rule names and the rule survives the compromise, so the high band alerts immediately. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-485 for the 55-74 log band).

Mailbox rule setup, command-line tier (mailbox_rule.enable, off by default): MailboxRuleDetector 60 = inbox-rule cmdlet (New-InboxRule / Set-InboxRule) observed on the command line without confirmed external forwarding. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune before EDR-484 fires.

LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning, tool tier (llmnr_poison.enable, off by default): LlmnrPoisonDetector 75 = known poison tooling (Inveigh, Responder, NBNS spoof shapes) answering name-resolution requests. Captured NTLMv2 hashes crack offline into domain credentials. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-487 for the 55-74 log band).

LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning, adjacent-activity band (llmnr_poison.enable, off by default): LlmnrPoisonDetector 55-74 = poisoning-adjacent signals below the tool tier. Logged at the suspicious floor so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-486 fires.

Network provider DLL persistence (netprovider_persist.enable, off by default): NetProviderPersistDetector 90 = ProviderPath pointing outside the Windows system directories, 85 = NetworkProvider\Order key reorder or ProviderPath value write without verifiable system-directory data. A malicious provider DLL loads into every logon session that touches the network and captures credentials at logon (T1556.008). Tuning: every non-system-directory ProviderPath scores 90, including legitimate third-party VPN or network providers, so adjust thresholds or allowlists per environment. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here.

Password vault theft, extraction tiers (password_vault.enable, off by default): PasswordVaultDetector 90 = keepass2john hash extraction, 85 = Bitwarden CLI export, 80 = vault database staged with an export/copy/archive verb. These convert the whole credential store into a crackable artifact (T1555.005). Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-490 for the 55-74 log band).

Password vault theft, CLI-use tier (password_vault.enable, off by default): PasswordVaultDetector 70 = keepassxc-cli export subcommand, 60 = non-interactive keepassxc-cli use or 1Password CLI bulk reads (op item list / op read). Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-489 fires.

Mailbox delegate permission grants, full-access/send-as tiers (mailbox_delegate.enable, off by default): MailboxDelegateDetector 85 = Add-MailboxPermission / Add-ADPermission granting FullAccess, 80 = Add-RecipientPermission SendAs / Set-Mailbox -GrantSendOnBehalfTo / Add-ADPermission extended 'Send As'. Delegating a victim's mailbox to an attacker-controlled account is the core BEC persistence move: the attacker reads the victim's mail and speaks as the victim without touching a password (T1098.002). Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-492 for the 55-74 log band).

Mailbox delegate permission grants, folder-permission tier (mailbox_delegate.enable, off by default): MailboxDelegateDetector 65 = Add-MailboxFolderPermission granting a second account read over the victim's folders. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-491 fires. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band.

ARP cache poisoning, poisoner tooling (arp_poison.enable, off by default): ArpPoisonDetector 80 = ettercap / bettercap / arpspoof invoked on the command or PowerShell script plane (word-start bounded, so 'xettercap' / 'myarpspoof' / vendor 'dnscap' stay silent and the 'ettercap' stem inside 'bettercap' keeps tool attribution correct). Corrupting the IPv4 neighbor cache redirects a victim's traffic through the attacker, giving a MITM position for relay or capture (T1557.002). Complements EDR-378 (T1040 packet capture) - arpspoof and static table loads fire here only. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-494 for the 55-74 log band).

ARP cache poisoning, adjacent-activity band (arp_poison.enable, off by default). Placeholder: the detector's current reachable floor is 75 (tool and static-table signals all land in EDR-493's >=75 band), so no current signal produces 55-74 - kept as the already-routed band for future lower-tier signals. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band.

Account access removal (AccountOpDetector, always on): `net user <name> /delete` (70) and `net user <name> /active:no` (60) sit in the 55-74 band that EDR-326 (>=75) never sees, so before this rule the detector stamped account_delete / account_disable with no consumer. Deleting or disabling local accounts is a ransomware / destructive-attack precursor that removes the operator's own recovery path (T1531). The second match field keeps the other 55-74 signals (account_create, domain_account_create, local_group_add) out of this rule; the whole-token alternation keeps 'account_deleted' and 'domain_account_create' from matching.

Cloud instance metadata credential theft, endpoint tier (cloud_metadata.enable, off by default): CloudMetadataDetector 85 = the link-local IMDS endpoints (169.254.169.254 octet-bounded, fd00:ec2::254) or the GCP metadata DNS hosts (metadata.google.internal / metadata.goog); 80 = other providers' metadata hosts (metadata.tencentyun.com / metadata.azure.com / metadata.oraclecloud.com) and the Alibaba IMDS address 100.100.100.200. One unauthenticated GET to any of these returns the instance role's credentials or a bearer token (T1552.005). Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-497 for the 55-74 log band).

Cloud instance metadata credential theft, token-shape tier (cloud_metadata.enable, off by default): CloudMetadataDetector 70 = the metadata token-pull request shapes that survive host elision from the command text (x-aws-ec2-metadata-token, metadata-flavor, /metadata/identity/oauth2/token, /metadata/instance?api-version). Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-496 fires.

Disk content wipe, lower tiers (disk_wipe.enable, off by default): disk_wipe_score 55-74 = cipher /w free-space wipe (60) and PowerShell volume wipe (70). Fixes a dead band: these were the only reachable disk_wipe scores no rule consumed (cipher /w is MITRE's T1561.001 example). Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 75+ alerted by EDR-461.

Boot provider persistence, subkey tier (boot_provider_persist.enable, off by default): boot_provider_score 70 = a new subkey created under a boot provider registration path without a DLL value yet. Fixes a dead band: 70 was reachable but no rule consumed it (EDR-455 alerts 75+). Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band.

Group Policy Preferences credential theft, extraction tier (gpp_password.enable, off by default): GppPasswordDetector 90 = Get-GPPPassword / Get-GPPAutologon / Get-GPPDomainPassword / Get-CachedGPPPassword (one cmdlet enumerates SYSVOL and prints the decrypted passwords), 85 = standalone GPP decryptors (gpp-decrypt / gpprefdecrypt), 80 = a word-start-bounded `cpassword` token combined with a search verb (findstr / Select-String / grep / find / type), 75 = a SYSVOL path plus a GPP XML name (Groups.xml / Services.xml / ScheduledTasks.xml / Printers.xml / Drives.xml / DataSources.xml / Registry.xml). Microsoft published the GPP AES key, so cpassword is trivially decryptable (T1552.006). Complements GpoAbuseDetector (T1484.001), which owns the policy *write* face and leaves read-only gpresult / Get-GPO silent. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-501 for the 55-74 log band).

Group Policy Preferences credential theft, parser tier (gpp_password.enable, off by default): GppPasswordDetector 65 = a bare word-start-bounded `cpassword` token on the command or script plane (a GPP parser that never names a known tool). Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-500 fires.

Control Panel proxy execution (control_panel_proxy.enable, off by default): ControlPanelProxyDetector 85 = control.exe driving a `.inf` argument (the INF Install section runs - signed-binary code execution and a documented MOTW / AppLocker bypass), 80 = control.exe loading a `.cpl` that resolves into a user-writable or remote location (UNC `\\`, \AppData\ / \Temp\ / \Users\Public\ / \ProgramData\ / \Downloads\ / \Desktop\) - a dropped DLL payload, not a system applet. Every needle is word-start bounded, so a vendor binary such as connectwisecontrol.exe never matches; `control.exe main.cpl`, a System32 CPL path, `control.exe /name Microsoft.X` and bare `control.exe` are normal administration and stay silent. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-503 for the 55-74 log band).

Control Panel proxy execution, Control_RunDLL tier (control_panel_proxy.enable, off by default): ControlPanelProxyDetector 70 = the `rundll32.exe shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL <file>.cpl` shape when control.exe itself is not named and the CPL resolves into a user-writable or remote location - the same CPL/DLL execution primitive reached through rundll32 (T1218.002). `Control_RunDLL main.cpl` (System32 applet) stays silent. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-502 fires.

Hidden local account (hidden_user_account.enable, off by default): HiddenUserAccountDetector 85 = a Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\UserList value written with data 0 (the account authenticates normally but never appears on the logon screen or Start menu), or a command-plane write whose text states an explicit zero-data shape (/d 0, dword:0, -Value 0, = 0), 75 = a UserList write whose data is unreadable (driver-shape REG_WRITE carries only the value name). Concealing an account is the standard step after adding a backdoor local administrator (T1564.002). Complements account_op (T1136.001 account creation) and local_account: those own the account lifecycle, this owns the concealment write. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-505 for the 55-74 log band).

Hidden local account, lower tiers (hidden_user_account.enable, off by default): HiddenUserAccountDetector 70 = a UserList value written with non-zero data (an account being un-hidden, or a benign UserList edit), 65 = a command-plane WRITE to the SpecialAccounts\UserList path (reg add / New-ItemProperty / Set-ItemProperty / Add-ItemProperty) without a recognizable zero-data shape - bare reg query never scores. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-504 fires.

Password policy discovery (password_policy_discovery.enable, off by default): PasswordPolicyDiscoveryDetector 75 = the AD policy cmdlets that exist only to read the policy (Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy / Get-ADFineGrainedPasswordPolicy / Get-ADUserResultantPasswordPolicy / Get-DomainPolicy). Reading the lockout threshold and minimum length is the sizing step before password spray or offline cracking (T1201). Complements password_spray / password_cracking, which own the attack that follows. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-507 for the 55-74 log band).

Password policy discovery, built-in read tiers (password_policy_discovery.enable, off by default): PasswordPolicyDiscoveryDetector 70 = `net accounts /domain` (domain policy read), 65 = bare `net accounts` (local policy read) and `secedit /export` (local security policy dump). The detector deliberately ignores any `net accounts` carrying a setter flag (/minpwlen, /maxpwage, /minpwage, /uniquepw, /lockoutthreshold, /lockoutduration, /lockoutwindow, /forcelogoff) - that is a policy MODIFICATION owned by account_op, not a discovery. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-506 fires.

MSI package install abuse, remote package tier (msi_package_install.enable, off by default): MsiPackageInstallDetector 85 = msiexec invoked with an install verb (/i, /package, /a) and a package that comes from a URL (http / https / ftp) or a UNC share. msiexec is Microsoft-signed and trusted, so fetching the package straight from attacker infrastructure turns it into proxy execution whose custom actions run with msiexec's privileges (T1546.016). Complements lolbin_parent_child / lolbin_chain, which own the generic "known LOLBin spawned / chained" faces and do not key on the package source. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-509 for the 55-74 log band).

MSI package install abuse, staged package tier (msi_package_install.enable, off by default): MsiPackageInstallDetector 70 = msiexec invoked with an install verb and a package resolving into a user-writable location (\AppData\, \Temp\, \Users\Public\, \ProgramData\, \Downloads\, \Desktop\) - a dropped file rather than a deployed product. A package under Program Files or any other non-user-writable path is a normal deployment and stays silent, as do msiexec invocations without an install verb (/x uninstall, /p patch, /unreg). Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-508 fires.

Event log enumeration targeting the defensive channels (log_enumeration.enable, off by default): LogEnumerationDetector 75 = an inventory enumeration or per-log configuration query that names a security-relevant channel (Security, Sysmon, Defender, Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell, WinRM, Terminal Services, AppLocker, CodeIntegrity, SMBClient, WDAC). Asking specifically which defensive channels exist and how they are configured is the sizing step before clearing or disabling them (T1654). Complements eventlog_tamper (T1070.001 / T1562.002) and defense_evasion (audit_log_tamper), which own the tamper action itself; this rule owns the reconnaissance that precedes it. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; 55+ alerted, 75+ here (see EDR-511 for the 55-74 log band).

Event log enumeration, inventory tiers (log_enumeration.enable, off by default): LogEnumerationDetector 65 = bulk enumeration of the log inventory (`wevtutil el`, `Get-WinEvent -ListLog ...`, `Get-EventLog -List`), 60 = per-log configuration read that does not name a defensive channel (`wevtutil gl`, `Get-WinEvent -ListProvider`). `wevtutil clear-log` / `cl` / `sl` and `wevtutil qe` deliberately do not match - clearing and disabling are tamper (eventlog_tamper / defense_evasion) and query-events is content reading, not inventory. Logged at the suspicious floor (55-74) so operators can tune thresholds before EDR-510 fires.

REG_WRITE registering a print/port monitor via the driver/imonitor event shape, where reg_key ends at the monitor key and reg_value carries the value name: writing the Driver value under Control\Print\Monitors\<name> registers a monitor DLL that loads at boot. Mirrors EDR-148, which only matches the snapshot shape (reg_key ending in \Driver with the DLL path as reg_value); this rule makes the kernel/imonitor surface reachable. Legitimate printer-monitor installs (e.g. LANMANPRINT) share this signature, so tune per environment. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band.
Soft obfuscation evidence only: statistical entropy/base64/symbol signals without structural evidence. Log for investigation, never a standalone malicious verdict or response instruction.

Soft lexical DGA evidence (dns_beacon.enable, off by default). Score 60+ combines label entropy, vowel ratio, consonant runs, digit/letter alternation and length. No process attribution is needed; alone it does not prove C2 or request response.

Learned behavior baseline deviation, suspicious band (behavior_baseline.enable, off by default): BehaviorBaselineDetector score 55-74 = at least two of the three categories (unseen child image 40, unseen write directory 30, unseen endpoint 30) deviating from the frozen per-image baseline. T1059/T1005/T1071 cover the three category faces; behavior_baseline_signals names which ones actually fired. Deviation is heuristic, not confirmed compromise: software updates and new deployments legitimately add children, directories and endpoints, so this band is logged for tuning while the baseline settles. Deliberately excludes the 50-54 dead band; see EDR-516 for the 75+ band.

Learned behavior baseline deviation, high band (behavior_baseline.enable, off by default): BehaviorBaselineDetector score 75+ = the image deviated in all three learned categories (unseen child 40 + unseen write directory 30 + unseen endpoint 30 = 100) inside the deviation window. Three simultaneous new behaviors on one program is the full-band shape this detector reserves for alerting; two-category deviation stays in EDR-515. The baseline never requests terminate/isolate/quarantine and alerts describe deviation, not confirmed compromise.

Opt-in logon_success detector: same endpoint/source, remote address and domain-qualified account failed at least min_failures within a bounded rolling window before a remote successful logon. Score 75 is investigative correlation, not proof of compromise; alert only, never automatic response. Separate from multi-account password spray.

Opt-in dns_failure: bounded process-instance window with enough completed 0/9003 queries, distinct name-error queries and name-error percentage. Score 55 is statistical investigative evidence; logging only. Unknown DNS status is excluded. No automatic response.

Opt-in dns_failure score 75 additionally requires multiple high-entropy name-error queries in the same reliable process instance. Multiple statistical signals merit investigation but do not prove C2; alert only, never terminate/isolate/quarantine.

Opt-in threat_intel feed matched the current SHA-256 of a configured FIM watch file on an added or modified transition. Artifact-local evidence; no actor PID or execution is inferred. Removed files and unknown baselines are excluded. The mapping is an investigative lead for a malicious-file execution risk, not evidence that execution occurred.
